clauses.why: The verse names Jehoram, spelled Joram in the verses just before, and says he was struck between the arms; 'how it was done' is minor but the arrow is stated.
clauses.english: killed Joram with an arrow from his bow
clauses.ukr: убив Єгорама стрілою зі свого лука
clauses.deu: erschoss Joram mit einem Pfeil aus seinem Bogen
clauses.spa: mató a Joram con una flecha de su arco

clauses.english: killed all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel
clauses.ukr: повбивав усіх позосталих з Ахавого дому в Їзреелі
clauses.deu: schlug alle übrigen vom Hause Ahab zu Jesreel
clauses.spa: mató a todos los que habían quedado de la casa de Achâb en Jezreel

clauses.why: Jehu ordered the guard and captains to slay them, and the verses name the house of Baal as the place; the citation should end at the slaying and the clause says he had them slain by his order.
clauses.english: had all the worshippers of Baal slain in the house of Baal by trickery
clauses.ukr: підступом звелів повбивати всіх, хто служить Ваалові, у Ваалових домі
clauses.deu: ließ mit Hinterlist alle Diener Baals im Haus Baals erschlagen
clauses.spa: hizo matar con astucia a todos los siervos de Baal en el templo de Baal
